Get help in Arizona

Let’s talk about what you need.

Call The Tree of LIF. You do not need to share our faith to ask for help.

Call (402) 870-8800

Or send a text, or message us on WhatsApp.

We are a small team, not an emergency service. If we miss your call, leave a message with a safe way to reach you.

What we can help with

  • Food and clothing for people experiencing homelessness.
  • Finding shelter options.
  • Support when coming home from incarceration.
  • Finding a drug or alcohol treatment or recovery program.

What to expect when you call

Tell us your first name, where you are, and what you need most right now. We will talk through the support available and the possible next steps.

Help depends on current resources. We cannot promise housing, a treatment place, or money.

Other places to get support, any time

Emergency

Call 911

Immediate danger or a medical emergency.

988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline

Call 988

Text 988 or chat online. Free and confidential.

Arizona 211

Call 211

Local services, including food and housing. 211arizona.org

SAMHSA National Helpline

1-800-662-4357

Treatment referral and information for drug and alcohol use. Free, confidential, every day.
